{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-gauge turtleneck knit, relaxed fit, hip length, saffron mustard #D9A22B, extra-fine merino wool
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight drape, ankle length, deep aubergine #3E1B3F, wool crepe
Waterproof trench coat, belted, hooded, A-line flare, just below the knee, emerald green #0B6E4F, matte technical cotton-blend with a waterproof finish
Ankle boots, block heel, rounded toe, side zip, black #1A1A1A, waterproof smooth leather
Structured crossbody bag, medium size, with a short strap, cognac #8B4A2B, grained leather
Statement hoop earrings, large and slightly chunky, polished gold #C9A227, gold-plated metal
Compact folding umbrella, black #111111, water-repellent nylon

This outfit is built for a cold, wet, windy evening, so the hooded waterproof trench and the boots with a grippy block heel keep you dry and steady from the cinema to dinner. The emerald coat over a saffron knit and aubergine trousers is a bold jewel-tone mix that stands out in the dark and looks rich against your deep skin tone and dark hair. The turtleneck and the long, fluid trousers cover you well against the wind while still looking neat and polished for a dinner out.
